findings.current: The choice of words almost made me laugh.
findings.defect: The source says an involuntary scoff or derisive laugh actually escapes Taekyung; the draft changes the action into a reaction that nearly happens but does not.
findings.rationale: 튀어나오는 describes the laugh bursting out, not merely being contemplated or suppressed.
findings.replacement: A scoff escaped me at his choice of words.

findings.current: “Although the attempt failed, murdering a member of the imperial family is the gravest of crimes. We immediately mobilized every fleet and soldier within the city so that these insolent rebels could be made an example of—”
findings.defect: The draft calls the failed attempt a completed murder and states that the forces have already been mobilized. The interrupted Korean presents immediate mobilization and punishment as the officer’s intended next action.
findings.rationale: 미수 explicitly means the assassination remained an attempt, while 즉시…총동원하여 introduces the proposed response that Taekyung interrupts rather than reporting a completed deployment.
findings.replacement: “Although they failed, attempting to assassinate a member of the imperial family is the gravest of crimes. We will immediately mobilize the entire fleet and all forces in the city and make an example of these insolent rebels—”
findings.source: 비록 미수에 그쳤으나 황족 시해는 중죄 중의 중죄. 즉시 성내의 함대와 병력을 총동원하여 이 무엄한 역도들을 일벌백계……!

findings.current: “What do you mean, ‘and’! I have heard plenty about the miraculous abilities of martial artists like you, but this is absurd. How could anyone swim so quickly across such a vast body of water? How could a single person sink dozens of vessels, including the Great Nation’s warships?”
findings.defect: The draft omits the officer’s statement that even the Yangtze River Channel League water bandits he has encountered were incapable of such feats. This removes the premise Honglan directly rebuts when she refers to the water bandits he knows.
findings.rationale: The omitted sentence establishes the officer’s practical frame of reference and creates the explicit connection to Honglan’s ensuing comparison with those same water bandits.
findings.replacement: “What do you mean, ‘and’! I have heard plenty about the miraculous abilities of martial artists like you, but this is absurd. Even the water bandits of the Yangtze River Channel League whom I have encountered were never capable of such feats. How could anyone swim so quickly across such a vast body of water, much less sink dozens of vessels single-handedly, including the Great Nation’s warships?”
findings.source: 종종 마주쳤던 장강수로맹의 수적들도 그 정도는 아니오. 한데 이 넓은 강물 위를 어찌 그리 빠르게 헤엄칠 것이며, 대국의 군선을 비롯한 수십 척의 선박을 단신으로 수장시킬 수 있……!

findings.defect: The source is a faltering, unfinished response rather than an affirmative claim that the officer knows the fact.
findings.rationale: 그, 그건 trails off before making any assertion, preserving the officer’s discomfort and inability to answer Gung Gibang.

findings.current: A fortunate distant imperial relative who had set a pleasure boat afloat on Dongting Lake despite the troubled atmosphere of the times.
findings.defect: “Fortunate” loses the disparaging implication that Ju Wongong is carefree and living comfortably enough to indulge himself despite the unrest.
findings.rationale: 팔자 좋은 is an ironic judgment about someone enjoying an easy, enviable lot, not a neutral statement that he is fortunate.
findings.replacement: A carefree distant imperial relative who had taken a pleasure boat out on Dongting Lake despite the troubled atmosphere of the times.
findings.source: 요즘 같은 불온한 분위기 속에서도 동정호에 놀잇배를 띄운 팔자 좋은 방계 황족.

summary: Five actionable findings: the draft changes an actual reaction into an unrealized one, presents a planned mobilization as completed, omits a comparison essential to the officer’s disbelief and Honglan’s reply, overstates the officer’s acknowledgment, and weakens Taekyung’s disparaging description of Ju Wongong.
